library.title: Choosing the regime (individual/HUF)
library.text: New regime is the default. Salaried individuals can choose regime each year in the return. Persons with business income can opt out once and switch back only once. Under the new regime most deductions (80C, 80D, HRA, LTA, 24(b) self-occupied) are unavailable; standard deduction Rs 75,000, employer NPS 80CCD(2) at 14% and 80CCH (Agniveer) remain.

library.title: Rebate - new regime
library.text: Resident individual with total income up to Rs 12,00,000: rebate up to Rs 60,000. Marginal relief above Rs 12 lakh so that tax does not exceed income above Rs 12 lakh. Rebate is not available against tax on special-rate income (111A, 112A, winnings).

library.title: Rebate - old regime
library.text: Resident individual with total income up to Rs 5,00,000: rebate up to Rs 12,500. Not available against tax on LTCG u/s 112A.

library.title: Presumptive business - 44AD
library.text: Eligible: resident individual, HUF, partnership firm (not LLP). Turnover up to Rs 2 Cr, or Rs 3 Cr if cash receipts do not exceed 5%. Income deemed 6% of digital receipts and 8% of other receipts (higher actual may be declared). Advance tax fully by 15 March. Opting out triggers 5-year lock-out.

library.title: Presumptive profession - 44ADA
library.text: Eligible: resident individual / partnership firm (not LLP) in specified professions u/s 44AA(1). Gross receipts up to Rs 50 lakh, or Rs 75 lakh if cash receipts do not exceed 5%. Income deemed 50% of receipts.

library.title: Presumptive transport - 44AE
library.text: Owner of not more than 10 goods carriages. Heavy goods vehicle: Rs 1,000 per ton of gross vehicle weight per month; others Rs 7,500 per vehicle per month.

library.title: Corporate concessional regime
library.text: Domestic company may opt for 22% + 10% surcharge + 4% cess (25.168%) foregoing specified deductions/incentives. MAT does not apply. From TY 2026-27 brought-forward MAT credit can be set off only under this regime, capped at 25% of tax liability.

library.title: MAT from Tax Year 2026-27
library.text: MAT rate reduced to 14% of book profit and becomes a final tax for domestic companies in the normal regime; no fresh MAT credit. Effective rate approx 16.31% (with 12% surcharge and cess).

library.title: Capital gains rates
library.text: Transfers on or after 23-07-2024: STCG on listed equity/equity MF (STT paid) 20%; LTCG on listed equity 12.5% above Rs 1.25 lakh; other LTCG 12.5% without indexation. Resident individual/HUF selling land or building acquired before 23-07-2024 may compute 20% with indexation if lower. Holding period: 12 months for listed securities, 24 months for others. Specified MF / market-linked debentures are always short-term.

library.title: Exemptions on capital gains
library.text: 54: LTCG on residential house reinvested in one house in India (cap Rs 10 Cr). 54F: LTCG on other asset, net consideration invested in a house (cap Rs 10 Cr; must not own more than one other house). 54EC: LTCG on land/building invested in specified bonds within 6 months, max Rs 50 lakh, 5-year lock-in. 54B agricultural land.

library.title: Buy-back of shares
library.text: From 01-04-2026 buy-back consideration is taxed as capital gains in the shareholder's hands (not deemed dividend); promoters bear an additional tax so that effective rate is higher. Verify current provision before advising.

library.title: Startup tax holiday
library.text: DPIIT-recognised eligible startup (incorporated up to 31-03-2030) can claim 100% deduction of profits for any 3 consecutive years out of first 10 years, with IMB certificate.

library.title: HUF as a planning tool
library.text: HUF is a separate assessee with its own basic exemption and deductions (80C, 80D under old regime). Income from ancestral property, gifts on partition-free basis and business carried on by HUF can be taxed in its hands. Clubbing (s.64(2)) applies to individual's property converted into HUF property.

library.title: Interest for defaults
library.text: 234A: 1% per month for late filing on tax unpaid. 234B: 1% per month if advance tax paid is less than 90% of assessed tax, from 1 April after the tax year. 234C: 1% per month on instalment shortfall (3 months each for Jun/Sep/Dec, 1 month for Mar); 12% and 36% safe margins for Jun and Sep.

library.title: Return due dates (from Finance Act 2026)
library.tags: due date ITR 31 August revised 31 March
library.text: 31 July: ITR-1 / ITR-2 filers. 31 August: non-audit business/profession and trusts. 31 October: audit cases. 30 November: transfer pricing. Belated: 31 December. Revised return up to 31 March (fee after 31 December). Updated return within 4 years.

library.title: Income-tax Act 2025 - transition
library.text: Income-tax Act 2025 applies from 01-04-2026. 'Tax year' replaces previous year/assessment year. Proceedings for years up to FY 2025-26 continue under the 1961 Act. TDS: s.392 salary, s.393 other payments; TCS: s.394; MAT: s.206.

portalGuides.title: File an income-tax return online
steps: Log in at https://www.incometax.gov.in with PAN (or as the client's Authorised Representative / ERI).
Go to e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return.
Select Assessment Year, mode Online, status (Individual/HUF/Others) and the ITR form TaxDesk suggests (Tax audit & ITR form screen).
Check the pre-filled data against the TaxDesk computation and AIS; add missing income and deductions schedule-wise (use the ITR data sheet).
Confirm tax payable matches TaxDesk; pay any balance through e-Pay Tax first (Challan type: Self-assessment tax).
Preview, validate, submit and e-verify (Aadhaar OTP / net banking / DSC) within 30 days.

portalGuides.title: File using the offline utility / JSON upload
steps: Download the Common Offline Utility (ITR 1-4) or the Excel utility for ITR-5/6/7 from the downloads page.
In the utility: import the pre-filled JSON (downloaded from e-File > Income Tax Returns > Download Pre-filled Data).
Key in the figures from the TaxDesk ITR data sheet and validate.
Generate the JSON and upload it at e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return > Mode: Offline.
E-verify the return.

portalGuides.title: Pay tax (advance / self-assessment / demand)
steps: Open e-Pay Tax (link above) or log in and go to e-File > e-Pay Tax.
Enter PAN/TAN and mobile, verify OTP.
Select Income Tax, the Assessment/Tax Year and the type of payment (Advance tax, Self-assessment tax, Regular assessment, TDS/TCS).
Enter the amounts (tax, surcharge, cess, interest, fee) as computed in TaxDesk.
Pay by net banking, debit card, UPI or NEFT/RTGS mandate; download the challan (CIN) and record it.

portalGuides.title: Download AIS, TIS and Form 26AS
steps: Log in to the e-filing portal.
AIS: go to Services > Annual Information Statement (AIS), open AIS, download as PDF or JSON.
26AS: e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Form 26AS, proceed to TRACES and download for the year.
Give feedback in AIS for any wrong entries before filing the return.

portalGuides.title: Link Aadhaar with PAN
steps: Open the Link Aadhaar page (link above).
Enter PAN and Aadhaar; if the late fee is unpaid, pay it via e-Pay Tax first.
Verify with Aadhaar OTP and submit; check status under Link Aadhaar Status.

portalGuides.title: Reply to a notice (e-Proceedings)
steps: Log in; go to Pending Actions > e-Proceedings.
Open the notice, note the DIN and response due date (record it in TaxDesk Notices).
Click Submit Response, attach the reply PDF and evidence (max size per file as shown), submit.
For faceless assessments, request a personal hearing / adjournment from the same screen if needed.

portalGuides.title: Rectification u/s 154 / refund reissue
steps: Log in; go to Services > Rectification (or Services > Refund Reissue).
Choose the assessment year and the type of request (reprocess, tax credit mismatch, status correction).
Attach supporting documents and submit; track under the same menu.

portalGuides.title: Add a CA / authorise a representative
steps: Client logs in; go to My CA > Add CA, enter the CA membership number and assign forms (e.g. 3CA-3CD, 3CB-3CD, 10B).
For filing on behalf: Authorised Partners > Register as Representative, attach authorisation.
CA accepts the assignment from Worklist > For your action.

portalGuides.title: Opt out of the new regime (business income) - Form 10-IEA
steps: Log in; e-File > Income Tax Forms > File Income Tax Forms.
Select Form 10-IEA, the assessment year, fill details and submit before the return due date u/s 139(1).
Quote the acknowledgement number in the ITR.

portalGuides.title: File TDS / TCS statements
steps: Prepare the statement in the Return Preparation Utility (RPU) from the Protean TIN site using the TDS details recorded in TaxDesk.
Download the latest challan status (CSI) file from the e-filing portal and validate with the File Validation Utility (FVU).
Upload the .fvu file on the e-filing portal: e-File > Income Tax Forms > TDS > Upload TDS, e-verify with DSC/EVC.
Download Form 16/16A from TRACES (https://www.tdscpc.gov.in) after processing.

portalGuides.title: Lower / nil TDS certificate
steps: Log in to TRACES as taxpayer.
Statements/Forms > Request for lower deduction certificate (Form 13 equivalent).
Enter estimated income, deductor TANs and amounts, attach financials and submit; certificate is emailed and visible on TRACES.

portalGuides.title: Apply for PAN
steps: Prepare the application in TaxDesk (PAN / TAN applications screen) and collect the documents listed.
Open Protean (link above) or UTIITSL (https://www.pan.utiitsl.com).
Choose New PAN: Form 93 (Indian citizen), Form 94 (Indian company/firm/LLP/HUF/AOP/trust), Form 95 (foreign citizen), Form 96 (foreign entity).
Fill details exactly as in the TaxDesk sheet, upload proofs, pay the fee, e-sign with Aadhaar OTP or send signed documents.
Note the 15-digit acknowledgement number in TaxDesk Work register; track status on the same site.

portalGuides.title: Apply for TAN
steps: Prepare the TAN application in TaxDesk: Form 134 (Government deductor) or Form 135 (others).
Apply online on the Protean TIN site (link above) > Services > TAN > Apply online.
Fill details incl. PAN, name, designation and phone of the person responsible, pay the fee and submit.
Send the signed acknowledgement if required; record the acknowledgement number in TaxDesk.
